items.title: 69537_Jimmy Jones oral history interview
items.q: it was Lil Greenwood, Jimmy Grissom, Joya Sherrill (PHONETIC).

ctx.x: It's never quite direct, you know. So he says, "Hey, James, this is Eddie Ellington." I said, "Hi, Edward, how do you feel?" So he says, "I have some singers I want you to take a look at," and it was Lil Greenwood, Jimmy Grissom, Joya Sherrill (PHONETIC). When I wound up I was out of town. I was back on the road, in Chicago. I left
New York, you know? So he says -- then there was a choir there that I had to work with, you know, and the next thing I knew I was in McCormack -- it was McCormack Place in Chicago.
